parameters.query: INSERT INTO n8n_elite_memory_events (request_id,key,value) VALUES ($1,$2,$3::jsonb) RETURNING id,request_id,key,value,created_at;
INSERT INTO n8n_elite_memory_kv (key,value,updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2::jsonb,NOW()) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=EXCLUDED.value, updated_at=NOW() RETURNING key,value,updated_at;
SELECT key,value,updated_at FROM n8n_elite_memory_kv WHERE key=$1;

SELECT id,request_id,key,value,created_at
FROM n8n_elite_memory_events
WHERE ($1 = '' OR request_id = $1)
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT $2;
SELECT id,request_id,key,value,created_at FROM n8n_elite_memory_events WHERE request_id=$1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2;
